description: This file defines template classes for vertex data conversion, including type casting, normalization, and array conversion for graphics buffer processing in a Direct3D 9 rendering context.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: Template for identity transformation, returns input as output.

classes.name: Cast
classes.description: Template for casting between different types, with specialization for same type.

classes.name: Normalize
classes.description: Template for normalizing numeric types to float range.

classes.name: FixedToFloat
classes.description: Template for converting fixed-point types to float.

classes.name: NoWiden
classes.description: Template for no widening of component count.

classes.name: WidenToEven
classes.description: Template for widening component count to even number.

classes.name: WidenToFour
classes.description: Template for widening component count to four.

classes.name: SimpleDefaultValues
classes.description: Provides default zero and one values for types.

classes.name: NormalizedDefaultValues
classes.description: Provides default zero and max (one) values for normalized types.

classes.name: VertexDataConverter
classes.description: Template class for converting arrays of vertex data with support for widening, type conversion, and default values.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a single element from input to output type.

methods.name: convertArray
methods.description: Converts an array of vertices from input to output format, handling stride and component conversion.

methods.name: copyComponent
methods.description: Copies and converts a single component from input to output, applying default values if necessary.
